svg.title: Label transfer: a low-resolution spectrum of one star goes into a neural network; labels with uncertainties come out (Teff 4,812 ± 41 K, log g 2.61 ± 0.07, [Fe/H] −0.34 ± 0.04, [Mg/Fe] 0.12 ± 0.03) and place the star near the red clump of an illustrative Kiel diagram of about 650 stars coloured by [Fe/H].
